code:
# Illustrative SLI definitions for an inference endpoint
latency_sli:   % of requests < 300ms, measured at
               the load balancer, 5-min rolling window

throughput_sli: sustained req/sec served while
                latency_sli stays >= 99%, 1-hour window

availability_sli: % of requests returning a non-error,
                   non-timeout response
caption: Throughput is defined conditionally on latency — a raw req/sec number alone is meaningless.
